2929.title: Signed-in web links use an isolated browser
2929.rootCauseOneLine: The link resolver sends every HTTP link to a separate Electron session when the default in-app browser preference is on.
2929.proposedFix: Define an explicit host policy for links that require the external browser session, then route exact hosts and subdomains outside.
2929.caveats: The trust rule did not permit a live request to the service from the issue data. The focused route test fully reproduces the BB behavior.
